title: 第12章【冥婚】水鬼
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

很快，河水淹没了顾原的头顶，这片河仿佛无底洞一样地将顾原吸了进去，好在他是个游泳健将，所以才敢放心的进入杏花河。

整个人浸入水中，他的五感几乎失去了作用，耳边什么也听不到，眼前只能看到眼前。

河水浸泡着他，冰冷刺骨，整个人并不像是在水中一样，而是像在冰窖中一样。

黑暗的河水中，光几乎像是绝迹了一样，这并不正常，即使是傍晚，河水中也不会如此黑暗。

“呼！”

顾原浮出水面换了一大口气，回头一看自己竟然距离岸边有了十几米的距离，可自己才刚刚进入水里没多久，就算是自己游泳再厉害，也不可能在这么短的时间游出这么长距离。

河里，不对劲。

远处，一点亮光吸引了顾原的注意，他紧紧的盯着那团亮光，仿佛出现在哪里很久，但是他记得，刚才在岸边的时候，河中并没有任何的亮光。

这亮光就是从自己进入河里之后开始出现的。

顾原想起来，自己当初在找到绣花鞋的时候，也是先看到了亮光，才吸引了自己的注意。

这一次，同样的亮光，会不会也是因为出现拼图。

想到这里，顾原找准方向朝着亮光快速游了过去。

游了大概一分钟的时间，顾原浮出水面，额头上分不清是汗珠还是水珠，但领他震惊的是自己于亮光的距离丝毫没有拉进，仿佛自己刚才就一直在原地游泳一样。

正当顾原思考之际，脚下突然传来了冰凉的感觉，那感觉并不是水带来的，这种感觉比水更让人紧张。

就像是有什么东西抓住了自己的脚踝一样，并且不断的轻抚着自己。

是水草吗？

顾原心中想着，低下头看去，水面忽地变得漆黑无比，根本看不到水下，只能看到自己的倒影。

忽地，一阵风吹过，顾原觉得脖子处传来一阵寒意，加之身上已经湿透，顾原打了个冷战，低头一看，镜面般的水面中一张脸色惨白的小女孩的脸贴在自己的脖子处，正对着自己的笑着。

“我靠！”

顾原一惊，浑身发麻，头皮几乎炸开，他惊恐地转过头去，手已经不自觉地摸向了怀中的铜钱剑。

Page (1/3)

Soon, the river water covered Gu Yuan's head, and the river sucked Gu Yuan in like a bottomless pit. Fortunately, he was a good swimmer, so he dared to enter the Xinghua River with confidence.

His whole body was immersed in the water, and his five senses almost lost their function. He could not hear anything in his ears, and could only see what was in front of him.

The river water soaked him, and it was bitingly cold. It didn't feel like he was in water, but like he was in an ice cellar.

In the dark river, the light almost seems to have disappeared. This is not normal. Even in the evening, the river will not be so dark.

"Phew!"

Gu Yuan came out of the water and took a deep breath. When he looked back, he saw that he was more than ten meters away from the shore. However, he had just entered the water not long ago. Even if he was a good swimmer, he would not be able to swim such a long distance in such a short time.

Something is wrong in the river.

In the distance, a bright light attracted Gu Yuan's attention. He stared at the bright light closely, as if it had been there for a long time, but he remembered that when he was on the shore just now, there was no light in the river.

This light started to appear after I entered the river.

Gu Yuan remembered that when he found the embroidered shoes, he first saw the light, which attracted his attention.

This time, the same light will be caused by the appearance of puzzle pieces.

Thinking of this, Gu Yuan found the right direction and swam quickly towards the bright light.

After swimming for about a minute, Gu Yuan emerged from the water. He could not tell whether it was sweat or water drops on his forehead, but what shocked him was that he had not moved closer to the bright light at all, as if he had been swimming in place just now.

Just as Gu Yuan was thinking, a cold feeling suddenly came from his feet. The feeling was not caused by the water. This feeling was more stressful than the water.

It was as if something grabbed his ankle and kept stroking him.

Is it an aquatic plant?

Gu Yuan thought in his heart, lowered his head and looked, the water surface suddenly became extremely dark, he couldn't see under the water at all, he could only see his own reflection.

Suddenly, a gust of wind blew by, and Gu Yuan felt a chill on his neck. In addition, his body was already soaked. Gu Yuan shivered. He looked down and saw a pale little girl's face in the mirror-like water surface, pressed against his neck, smiling at him.

"Holy shit!"

Gu Yuan was startled, his whole body was numb, and his scalp almost exploded. He turned his head in horror, and his hand unconsciously touched the copper coin sword in his arms.
